title: Convention check reads configured source folders
goal: An Angular project whose app lives outside `src/` gets its conventions checked
acceptance: A `.harness.json` setting (`conventions.sourceDirs`, repository-relative folders) names the source roots; absent, the check reads `src/` as today
A path that is absolute, escapes the repository or does not exist is refused with its name
Fixture test: a project with its app in a nested folder reports a convention break there; a project without the setting behaves as before
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented projects; no personal data.
escalation: A default that changes what an existing project checks is a major release; ask first

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 at agent speed: one setting read by one copied check. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-25 (failing-first fixture test committed before the change); review, CI and release remain.
